findings.current: The figure that had been floating cross-legged in the air descended until his feet touched the ground
findings.defect: The draft changes his cross-legged body touching the ground into his feet touching it, an incompatible physical action.
findings.rationale: 신형 refers to his figure or body, not specifically his feet; he remains seated cross-legged.
findings.replacement: The figure that had been floating cross-legged in the air descended until his body touched the ground
findings.source: 가부좌를 튼 채 허공에 떠올라 있던 신형이 지면에 닿는 순간

findings.current: Once, when my grandfather sat me beside him at the age of nine, he said something similar.
findings.defect: The modifier placement makes it sound as though the grandfather may have been nine years old.
findings.rationale: 아홉 살이 된 저 explicitly identifies Zhuge Feng as the nine-year-old.
findings.replacement: Once, when I was nine, my grandfather sat me beside him and said something similar.
findings.source: 언젠가 조부께서 아홉 살이 된 저를 곁에 앉혀 두고 그런 말씀을 하셨지요.

findings.current: ‘I don’t know what kind of bastard is up there, but he must have a truly goddamn temperament.’
findings.defect: “Goddamn temperament” is an unnatural collocation and weakens the description of a foul disposition.
findings.rationale: 지랄 같은 성미 is strongly profane and describes an atrocious temper or disposition.
findings.replacement: ‘I don’t know what kind of bastard is up there, but he must have a truly god-awful temper.’
findings.source: 저 위에 어떤 놈이 있는지는 몰라도, 참으로 지랄 같은 성미를 지닌 것이 분명하다.

findings.current: The countless deaths caused by the tragedies in Henan and Sichuan were more than enough to remind him of the Great Faction War that had taken place in the past.
findings.defect: “Tragedies” softens 혈사, which specifically denotes bloody violence or bloodshed.
findings.rationale: 혈사 foregrounds lethal violence rather than tragedy in the general sense.
findings.replacement: The countless deaths caused by the bloodshed in Henan and Sichuan were more than enough to remind him of the Great Faction War.
findings.source: 하남과 사천의 혈사가 낳은 수많은 죽음은 과거 일어났던 정마대전을 떠올리기에 충분했다.

findings.defect: The draft omits 선객’s implication that Zhuge Feng was already there as an earlier guest.
findings.rationale: 선객 means a guest who arrived before the present visitor, not merely a guest currently present.
findings.replacement: “I see you already had a guest.”

findings.current: I also wondered why an exceptional medical apprentice known as the Divine Physician appeared only after the Great Faction War ended.
findings.defect: Calling the legendary Divine Physician a “medical apprentice” misstates his professional stature and makes Zhuge Feng’s deduction internally implausible.
findings.rationale: Here 의생 is being used generically for a medical practitioner, while 신의 identifies the renowned Divine Physician.
findings.replacement: I also wondered why the exceptional physician known as the Divine Physician only appeared after the Great Faction War ended.
findings.source: 어찌하여 신의라는 걸출한 의생이 정마대전이 끝난 후에야 등장했는가에 대해서도.

findings.current: “But why go out of your way to come to me… Unless?”
findings.defect: The draft says Mungyeong specifically came to Zhuge Feng, but he came to Jeok Cheongang; Zhuge Feng is asking why Mungyeong deliberately let him discover his identity.
findings.rationale: The omitted object after 굳이 제게 is supplied by the immediate exchange about Mungyeong’s concealed identity, and Mungyeong’s reply confirms Zhuge Feng has inferred his intention.
findings.replacement: “But why would you deliberately reveal yourself to me… Unless?”

findings.current: There was nothing but water in every direction, yet small islands and flat stretches of ground formed from mud and sand carried in by tributaries of the Yangtze were not difficult to find.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the negation: the source says the surroundings were not solely water, whereas the draft says there was nothing but water.
findings.rationale: 물만 있는 것이 아니라 explicitly negates the claim that water is the only surrounding terrain, supporting Taekyung’s plan to fight on land.
findings.replacement: It wasn’t all water in every direction; small islands and flat stretches of ground formed from mud and sand carried in by tributaries of the Yangtze were easy enough to find.
findings.source: 사방에 물만 있는 것이 아니라 작은 섬, 혹은 장강의 지류에서 흘러들어온 흙과 모래가 쌓여 축적된 평평한 지면도 어렵지 않게 볼 수 있었다.

summary: The draft contains two altered physical facts, one misidentified professional role, and several localized losses of implication, register, or natural phrasing.
